item.title: Shrimp social & swap meet
item.description: Our favourite night of the season: trade cuttings, colonies and coral frags, and meet the people behind the tanks.

item.title: Aquascaping night: planted tanks & CO₂
item.description: Layouts, substrate, light and the great CO₂ question. Bring photos of your scape, or your plans for one.

item.title: New tank 101
item.description: A gentle, hands-on introduction to setting up your first aquarium: tank size, cycling, stocking, and the mistakes we all made so you don’t have to.

item.title: Freshwater vs saltwater: the friendly debate
item.description: Two panels, one question, zero casualties. What each side wishes the other knew.

item.title: Field trip: Vancouver Aquarium
item.description: A group day trip to see how the professionals do it, and argue about which exhibit has the best aquascape.
